LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporatePeople.Title: Mugirl trading
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporatePeople.Intro: This week's Mugirls can join your colony as slaves. Review their skills, health and equipment. The corporation also purchases adult, legally transferable prisoners and slaves.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporatePeople.RequiresIdeology: Purchases require Ideology to join as colony slaves. This feature is disabled without it; purchases will not become free colonists.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporatePeople.NoOffers: No personnel are available this week. Sold places are replenished at the weekly rotation.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporatePeople.BuyConfirm: Pay {1} to purchase {0} as a slave and deliver them to {2}?\n\nAbilities, health and gear are shown on this page. Arrange slave living conditions and suppression after arrival. Caravan deliveries add a person and their carried equipment.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporatePeople.SaleWarning: Selling counts as slave trading, retaining vanilla family and ideology consequences. Colonists also receive “sent a mugirl to a ruthless corporation” (-8 mood for 8 days; another sale refreshes the duration).
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporatePeople.NoCandidates: No eligible adult mugirl prisoners or slaves are available here. Free colonists, visitors, temporary quest members and unsecured captives are excluded.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporatePeople.MapGear: Map transaction: worn apparel travels with the person. Weapons, inventory and weapon-wheel reserves are dropped locally through the vanilla trade process.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporatePeople.CaravanGear: Caravan transaction: apparel, equipment, inventory and weapon-wheel reserves travel with the person. Transfer anything you want to keep to another caravan member first.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporatePeople.SellConfirm:
Permanently sell {0} to the corporation for {1}?

This is slave trading and triggers vanilla family and ideology consequences. Colonists also receive -8 mood for 8 days for sending a mugirl to a ruthless corporation.

{2}

The person will no longer belong to the colony.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporatePeople.NoSilver: Insufficient silver in the current trade area.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporatePeople.NoNegotiator: No conscious free colonist is available to negotiate this transaction.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporatePeople.OfferChanged: The person, eligibility or price has changed. Select again.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporatePeople.InvalidContext: The trade location or communication access is no longer valid. Reconnect.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporatePeople.IdeoRefusal: The negotiator's ideology will not permit this slave sale.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporatePeople.DismountFirst: End this person's mounting relationship before trading.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporatePeople.DeliveryPending: Delivery is pending. Paid personnel or proceeds are preserved and can be claimed at a valid terminal without paying again.
